target_audience: Dewasa 18+ yang penasaran dan suka pengetahuan umum
content_rules: No medical, health, or financial advice; no unproven health or cure claims.
No conspiracy theories, pseudoscience, or unverified rumors presented as fact.
No graphic violence, gore, self-harm, or detailed descriptions of crimes or methods of harm.
No sexual or sexually suggestive content.
No politics, elections, religion-bashing, or content targeting ethnicity, race, or groups (SARA).
No dangerous challenges, drug use instructions, or illegal activities.
No defamation: do not make negative claims about living private individuals or specific companies.
Keep it advertiser-friendly: profanity-free and suitable for YouTube monetization.
